$schema_note: Hand-curated record of what is known about when a key dungeon's end chest (Dungeon_Chest_obj) opens and how many monsters a dungeon holds, NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file, and hs_game_sdk/dungeon_chest_model.py never reads it; tests/test_dungeon_chest_model.py reads both and checks that the model reproduces each entry, and that each of the model's HYPOTHESES stays None until a `measured` entry names it in `hypothesis` and carries `values.verdict` (true or false; for `planned_total_source`, 'variable' or 'estimate'). The mechanism, in our own words, is docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md. Every entry has `id` (DC1, DC2, ...), `kind` (`baseline` = vanilla, no lever; `target` = a ForgePact lever applied; `our_code` = a contract of ForgePact's own code, not the game), `status` (`static_reading` = read from the compiled game and paraphrased, no script text; `measured`; `reported` = a player's report, not a measurement of ours; `pending` = a placeholder a later ForgePact#31 live session fills; `not_observed`), `date`, `source` (either one string `<path> § <section>`, the path relative to the hub root and `section` text that appears in that file; or a Live capture's bare path under .claude/workorders/, which is local and only checked where it exists, with `capture_section` = text in the capture and `tracked_copy` = `<path> § <section> › <subsection>`, the committed write-up of the same session, each part text that appears in that file in that order), `scripts` (every gml_Script_* the entry involves, all bound in hs_game_sdk.scripts.GameScript; may be empty), `objects` (every object the entry involves, all in hs_game_sdk.objects.OBJECT_NAME_TO_INDEX, with the index the SDK gives), `what` (the observation), `values`, `model` (what the model must show), optionally `hypothesis` (the HYPOTHESES key the entry answers) and `live_check` (the live procedure check that measures it), optionally `cause_status` with `cause_note` (when `values.cause` has a weaker status than the entry: the values were measured, the cause was not), and exactly one of `reproduced_by` (the dotted id of the test that reproduces it) or `not_reproduced` (why it cannot be). DC1-DC5 are the static reading of 2026-10-03 (ForgePact#31's planning, a local Ghidra project of the current build; the decompiler output stayed on that machine). DC6 is Headhunter's measured kill path. DC7-DC13 are ForgePact#31's Live procedure 1 (2026-10-03, one Pumpkin Cellar run). DC14-DC19 are ForgePact#31's Live procedure 1b (2026-10-03, two Pumpkin Cellar runs in one launch): DC14-DC18 its checks, DC19 the mean of ForgePact's total estimate, which that session selected (total-route: estimate). DC20 is ForgePact#31's Live procedure 2, attempt 1 (2026-10-04, the player build): its census at the chest's first sight, and a kill count that stayed 0 because of ForgePact's own enemy check, not the game (a reading of ForgePact's code backed by that session's log, its `cause_status`, measured once DC21 credited the by-name path). DC21 is ForgePact#31's Live procedure 2, attempt 2 (2026-10-04, the fixed player build): the census, the kill count, the late latch D15 answers and the label flicker D14 answers. DC22-DC23 are ForgePact#31's Live procedure 3 (2026-10-04, the player build after D14 and D15): the latch at exactly the threshold, and the steady head label with the inherited font switching under it.

measurements.what: Dungeon_Chest_obj owns five events: Create, Step, Draw, Alarm 0 and Other 7 (animation end). Found through the exe's YYGMLFuncs rows, so object events are readable statically although symbols.csv lists only scripts.
measurements.model: Not modelled: which events the chest owns is structure, not arithmetic. Recorded so a later build's reading can be compared with it.
measurements.not_reproduced: An event list is not a number the model computes; the test checks only that the object and its index are the SDK's.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC2, the Step calls no named script that counts
measurements.what: The chest's Step calls, by name, GetKeyDungeonRoom, GetKeyDungeon, NetworkSendClientEffect, GPV, IsDefined and PlaySound3D. None of them counts or lists enemies.
measurements.model: The model takes the alive count as an input and does not say how the chest obtains it: chest_openable(alive) depends on nothing but alive.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC3, the open is the animation end
measurements.what: Other 7 (animation end) is the open: CreateInFreePos, an instance_create builtin call, SPV, ReturnSpecificStat, quest_exists, QuestComplete and CommunityQuestAddProgress. Alarm 0 calls ReturnSpecificStat and GPV; Create calls CheckTown, UpdateDepth and ReportClient.
measurements.model: Not modelled: the payout is out of ForgePact#31's scope and runs untouched.
measurements.not_reproduced: What the chest pays out is not what the model answers (when it may open); recorded so the mod's scope can be checked against it.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC4, the unlock condition is not visible statically
measurements.what: No body in this build calls a builtin directly (in 150 functions read only is_handle appeared as a direct call), and variables are read through slot ids, so an instance_number/instance_exists poll by the chest and the name of a variable it reads are both invisible statically: neither proven nor ruled out.
measurements.model: The static reading answers no hypothesis: HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_builtin_poll'] and HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_variable'] hold only what measured entries (DC10, DC9) say.

measurements.what: Dungeon_Boss_Blocker_obj has Create/Step/Draw and its Step calls quest_exists and GPV. Spawn_Dungeon_obj (Create/Step/Alarm 0/Draw; Alarm 0 calls sc_rift, StringStartsWith, GPV and creates an instance) is the world-side entrance spawner of the special-content family, not a monster spawner. Dungeon_Spawner_1..4_obj have only a small Create.
measurements.model: Not modelled: these objects are not where a dungeon's monsters come from; DC8 measured the creator family inside the dungeon instead.
measurements.not_reproduced: A static negative about these spawners is not a measurement; the creators that do spawn a dungeon's monsters are DC8's measured entry.

measurements.what: EnemyDestroyKillProc runs with the dying enemy as self and again with the player as self; Enemy_Death_Effect_obj is made on 50 of 307 kill-proc calls, so it is not a kill counter. Enemy_Parent_obj is the monster family.
measurements.model: Counting each enemy-self call once per instance id gives one kill per monster, and each kill adds 1/T to the progress over the planned total T (DC11 measured that tally reaching the dungeon's total at the clear).

measurements.what: Pumpkin Cellar (Pumpkin_Cellar_01_rm), research DLL 256d3ba4..., slot 14. The first per-second line in the dungeon read alive=5 and the next alive=44 (the owner: the 44 are the packs near the entrance); alive= then rose and fell as packs spawned while the player moved (44 -> 72 while kills stayed at 23; peak 210 at kills=260) until alive=0 at kills=600. Kills plus alive therefore is not the dungeon's population; a share over it would have called 50 % reached after 22 kills of 600.
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['all_monsters_alive_at_entry'] is False; along the measured (alive, kills) path kills + alive takes many values and only reaches the total (600) at the clear.

measurements.what: creators=122 on the first tick in the dungeon and on every per-second line until the clear at kills=600: every creator of the dungeon exists at entry, and a creator stays alive after it has spawned its pack (RDM 11.2's static reading, confirmed).
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['no_creators_in_dungeon'] is False. The creators can be counted at load, so the planned total is a sum over them: planned_total(0, counts) of 122 whole counts can carry the 600 measured.

measurements.what: At the last kill the only chest variable that changed was nearest (real -4 -> an instance reference), on the tick after alive=0 kills=600; on the open, about 13 s later, only builtin sprite_index (closed -> open sprite), image_index and image_speed. No GPV read row and no SPV write showed up in the session (store GPV gameCalls=2, SPV calls=0). Read as: once no enemy exists the chest looks for the nearest player and opens on approach; no unlock flag is written anywhere the probe watched.
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_variable'] is False: the chest's rule is its own poll (DC10), so the model's rule reads only the alive count.
measurements.not_reproduced: Which variables the chest writes is not arithmetic the model computes; the absence of an unlock flag is what keeps chest_openable a function of alive alone (DC10's test).

measurements.what: With the chest as self, instance_exists with Enemy_Parent_obj as its argument was called 3402 times by the time the dungeon had been entered (step 5) and 41519 times by the end, about once a frame. The chest also asked instance_exists about Player_obj (1897), Loot_Ground_obj (12) and objZoneGenV2 (12); instance_find and instance_place were not called with the chest as self (their detours saw the game's calls: gameCalls=631489 and 6422). Whether the chest calls instance_number is not observed, and the instrument could not see it: that detour attributed no call to any game self in the session (gameCalls=0), so its zero chest row is blind, not a measured negative.

chest_self_calls_not_observed.instance_number: blind: the detour attributed no call to any game self in Live 1 (gameCalls=0), so a chest call could not have shown

measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_builtin_poll'] is True, and chest_openable(alive) is that poll's 'no': true exactly when no monster is alive, whatever the dungeon's total.

measurements.what: The dungeon cleared at kills=600 alive=0; the kill hook counted one per kill (killHook=ok, killNotEnemySelf=0). That is about 4.9 monsters per creator over all 122, or (600 - 44) / 122, about 4.6, per creator if every creator was still to spawn once the 44 were alive. The kill-hook-fires check's literal wording (kills equal the drop in alive within 1) failed only because packs spawned inside the window.
measurements.model: The dungeon's total is 600: estimated_total(44, 122, 556/122) and planned_total(44, per-creator counts summing to 556) both give it.

measurements.what: blockers=0 on every line of the only dungeon run: a boss dungeon was not covered live (only Cellar Keys at hand).
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['boss_dungeon_same_rule'] stays None.
measurements.not_reproduced: Not observed: not covered live, only Pumpkin Cellar keys.

measurements.what: ChatAddServerMessage, called by name with the local player as self and one string argument (dispatched=1, ret=undefined), put a red line 'SERVER: <text>' bottom-left (chat-shape pass, n=1, screenshot in the capture). Inside, the game called ChatAddMessage with 15 arguments (sender string SERVER, the text, numbers, an [hh:mm] string, undefined values) and IngameChatFeedAddLatest. Offline, the player cannot type in chat (chat-hook-fires not observed).
measurements.model: Not modelled: this is the countdown's chat form, not the chest's rule.
measurements.not_reproduced: A chat call shape is not arithmetic; ForgePact's own harness and its chat callback carry it.

measurements.what: Live 1b run A (Pumpkin Cellar) read every numeric variable of the 122 creators at the chest's first sight (alive0=5, 5 creators already spawned, 20 names on the sampled ones) and compared each name's sum with the 619 kills to clear, over every creator and as alive0 plus the sum over the creators still to spawn. None came near (creator-sum not observed): the nearest were img (sum 112.67, 91 over the pending ones), isWormhole (19806532) and spawnPack (19970468). The names that sound like a pack size read as one large real per creator, rising from one creator to the next (about 163047 upward), not as a count. With DC16 passing, the total is the estimate (DC19).
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['planned_total_source'] is 'estimate': no per-creator count is read, and estimated_total is the form the mod uses (DC19).
measurements.not_reproduced: No variable matched, so there is no sum for the model to reproduce; DC19 reproduces the estimate that replaced it.

measurements.what: No creator variable matched what each creator then spawned: every candidate row read match=0/122 and matchPending=0/117 at the clear (creator-match not observed).
measurements.model: Not modelled: planned_total takes per-creator counts as given, and none exists to give it.
measurements.not_reproduced: Not observed: no candidate matched any creator's births.

measurements.what: The 8 sampled creators (Enemy_Creator_obj) read alarm[0]=5, enemyCreatorTimer undefined and enemyArray undefined at first sight; about 10 s later, armed, alarm[0] was -1 and enemyCreatorTimer a real (214 to 221); at the clear, spawned, enemyArray was an array and enemyCreatorTimer was no longer listed. So a creator still to spawn is one whose enemyArray is not an array; enemyCreatorTimer alone cannot tell, being undefined both before a creator arms and after it spawns.
measurements.model: estimated_total takes the count of creators still to spawn as given; ForgePact counts them by enemyArray.
measurements.not_reproduced: A variable's state is not arithmetic; ForgePact/tests/test_dungeon_chest_unlock_contract.py's test_total_source_reads_the_measured_route pins the read.

measurements.what: Run A cleared at kills=619 alive=0 with 644 births by creators (births0=5 at the census, 639 after it): alive0 plus the births since is 644, 25 more than the kills, and births alone are 644 too (kills-equal-births failed by 25). Some monsters a creator makes are never killed by the player and never keep the chest shut, so a total for the chest is counted in kills.
measurements.model: The mean per creator still to spawn (DC19) is taken over kills, never births.

measurements.what: Run B, dungeonchest 50 against an override total of 600: the threshold latched at 'unlocked early at 304/600 alive=214', ForgePact then answered the chest's own instance_exists(Enemy_Parent_obj) poll false 390 times (answered=390), and the chest's sprite went from closed to open at kills=325 alive=193. The chest opened with monsters alive (unlock-works pass); its drop was not checked by the operator.
measurements.model: Not modelled: the model gives when the mod may open the chest, not whether answering the poll opens it.
measurements.not_reproduced: Whether the game's chest opens is not arithmetic; ForgePact's harness pins the detour's decision (poll-answered-while-latched).

measurements.what: The estimate's mean, ForgePact's total source (total-route: estimate): T = alive at first sight + ceil(creators still to spawn x 614 / 117). From run A: 619 kills to clear, 5 alive at first sight, 122 creators of which 5 had spawned by then (spawned0=5), so 117 pending and (619 - 5) / 117, about 5.25 per pending creator, over kills (DC17). DungeonChestMod.hpp holds it as kEstimateKills = 614 and kEstimatePendingCreators = 117. If the 5 first-sight monsters were idle ones rather than packs, all 122 creators were pending and the same estimate gives 646 for that run; an over-count only raises the threshold. Live 1's (600 - 44) / 122, about 4.6, is a second point, not the constant.
measurements.model: estimated_total(5, 117, 614/117) is 619, and estimated_total(5, 122, 614/117) is 646.

measurements.what: Live procedure 2, attempt 1: the player DLL (round 4, sha256 b1f4f75f...) with the mod on at 50 % through the panel, slot 14, Pumpkin Cellar. The first status in the dungeon read total=646 creators=122 pending=122 unreadable=0 (all 122 creators still to spawn at the chest's first sight, so 646 = 641 for them plus 5 alive then; alive=42 by the read). kills stayed 0 on every read while the owner killed (alive 139 -> 135 -> 129, HUD DPS rising), with hook=ok and unlock=ok. The cause is ForgePact's own enemy check, not the game: it compared against Enemy_Parent_obj's index held in a global only the create-hook installer fills, which the player build runs only for features that need the create hooks, and the owner's saved mods had none; the session's out.txt has no 'Enemy_Parent_obj index =' line. Fixed after: the check resolves Enemy_Parent_obj by name on demand, and status prints notEnemy=.

values.cause: enemy check: Enemy_Parent_obj's index never resolved in the player build

measurements.cause_note: values.cause was a reading of ForgePact's own code in attempt 1 (with Enemy_Parent_obj's global at -1 the enemy check answers false whatever the hook sees), backed by that session's out.txt having no 'Enemy_Parent_obj index =' line. Live procedure 2's attempt 2 (DC21) measured it: on the fixed player build, with again no such line in that session's out.txt, kills=38 notEnemy=0 and killHook 0 -> 915, so the count came through the check's resolution by name (on-kills-count pass).
measurements.model: The total is DC19's total_if_all_pending: estimated_total(5, 122, 614/117) is 646. The kill count is ForgePact's code, not the game's.
measurements.not_reproduced: kills=0 was a defect in ForgePact's own enemy check (ForgePact tests/test_dungeon_chest_adapter.py pins it and its fix); the model covers the game only, and the total it reproduces is DC19's.

measurements.what: Live procedure 2, attempt 2: the fixed player DLL (sha256 ed3cab18...) with the mod on at 50 % through the panel, slot 14, Pumpkin Cellar. The census at the chest's first sight read total=642 creators=122 pending=122 unreadable=0, threshold=321. Kills counted: the first read showed kills=38 notEnemy=0 with killHook 0 -> 915 and no 'Enemy_Parent_obj index =' line in the session's out.txt (the enemy check's by-name path, DC20's cause). Every countdown form showed as picked (head label at 42 to go, chat lines with chatLines 0 -> 2, both at 29 to go). The latch came late, 'unlocked early at 333/642 alive=170', 12 kills past the threshold, because the decision ran only at the once-a-second poll (no-double-count fail, fixed after by D15, DC22); answered=9421 after the latch, and the chest opened with monsters alive (alive=163 right after, answered=15485). With the mod off the chest stayed shut until the clear. The head label drew at about 72 % size on 2 single frames of 272 captured in 1.001 s (181 px wide normally, 131 px on those two; on-head-steady fail, fixed after by D14, DC23).
measurements.model: estimated_total(alive0, 122, 614/117) is alive0 + 641, so total=642 means 1 monster alive at the chest's first sight by the estimate's arithmetic (alive0 itself was not read); 50 % of 642 rounded up is 321.
measurements.not_reproduced: The late latch and the label's size flicker are ForgePact's own code (decision timing and the font it drew in), pinned by ForgePact tests/test_dungeon_chest_adapter.py's LatchFixTests and LabelFixTests; alive0 was not read, so the total cannot be checked against the estimate; DC19 reproduces the estimate itself.

measurements.what: Live procedure 3: the player DLL rebuilt after D14 and D15 (sha256 3e55e5cd..., ForgePact 1f563bb), on at 50 %, form both, slot 14, Pumpkin Cellar. The census read total=646 creators=122 pending=122 unreadable=0, threshold=323. The session's only latch line was 'unlocked early at 323/646 alive=128', exactly at the threshold, and status then read latched=1 latchedAt=323 (latch-exact pass, D15 fixed). chatLines went 1 -> 11 and the owner saw the ready line (on-ready-chat). The chest opened with monsters alive: alive=113 just before, 103 right after, answered 1680 -> 8809.
measurements.model: The total is DC19's total_if_all_pending: estimated_total(5, 122, 614/117) is 646; 50 % of 646 rounded up is 323.
measurements.not_reproduced: Latching at the counted kill is ForgePact's own decision timing (ForgePact tests/test_dungeon_chest_adapter.py's LatchFixTests); whether answering the poll opens the chest is not arithmetic (DC18). The total it reports is DC19's, which DC19's test reproduces.

measurements.what: Live procedure 3, the head label (drawn from ForgePact's DrawHudBuffs hook after the game's own DrawHudBuffs returns): with the player standing still and 'Chest: 47 kills to go' up, a per-frame screen capture of the label's region caught 329 frames in 1.203 s, every one 225 px wide with 703 bright pixels and all one bitmap (on-head-steady pass; a control on moving characters gave 69 distinct bitmaps in 161 frames); labelFont=__newfont6. Both status reads showed inheritedFont=7 and inheritedUnread=0; across the stand-still (about 45 s) fontSwitches rose 62 -> 116, so 54 label draws found a different inherited font from the draw before, while guiResizes stayed 0. The font the game leaves current at that point switches from frame to frame and the GUI size does not: the cause of DC21's size flicker (font-cause, readable). Which game draw leaves the other font current is not established; the label's look (label-look) was not observed.
measurements.model: Not modelled: the model covers when the chest may open, not how the label is drawn.
measurements.not_reproduced: Drawing is not arithmetic; ForgePact tests/test_dungeon_chest_adapter.py's LabelFixTests pins the label's own font and its fontSwitches/guiResizes counters.
